description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value to make sure that it is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.
The details of the custom privacy policy content.
The name of the custom privacy policy.
The default language of the privacy policy.
The status of the custom privacy policy.
The consent type for the privacy policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-custom-privacy-policy --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --custom-privacy-policy-name Custom_Privacy_Policy_Name --status enabled --user-consent-type implied_consent --default-language-code zh-Hans-CN --custom-privacy-policy-contents '[{"LanguageCode":"zh-Hans-CN","CustomPrivacyPolicyTip":"Please_read_and_agree：","CustomPrivacyPolicyItems":[{"CustomPrivacyPolicyItemName":"Custom_Privacy_Policy_Name","CustomPrivacyPolicyItemUrl":"http://www.xxxx.com"}]}]' --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateCustomPrivacyPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Status enabled --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --CustomPrivacyPolicyName Custom_Privacy_Policy_Name --UserConsentType implied_consent --CustomPrivacyPolicyContents.1.LanguageCode 'zh-Hans-CN' --CustomPrivacyPolicyContents.1.CustomPrivacyPolicyItems.1.CustomPrivacyPolicyItemUrl 'http://www.xxxx.com' --CustomPrivacyPolicyContents.1.CustomPrivacyPolicyTip 'Please_read_and_agree：' --DefaultLanguageCode 'zh-Hans-CN' --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --CustomPrivacyPolicyContents.1.CustomPrivacyPolicyItems.1.CustomPrivacyPolicyItemName Custom_Privacy_Policy_Name --method POST --force
